theorems.name: empty_class_no_elements
theorems.formula: (forall z:Class. ((z in { x | _|_ }) -> _|_))
theorems.description: The empty class has no elements.

theorems.name: empty_class_is_subclass
theorems.formula: (forall X:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { x | _|_ }) -> (z in X))))
theorems.description: The empty class is a subclass of every class.

theorems.name: universal_class_characterization
theorems.formula: (forall z:Class. (((z in { x | Top }) -> Set(z)) /\ (Set(z) -> (z in { x | Top }))))
theorems.description: V = {x | Top}: membership in the universal class is exactly sethood.

theorems.name: russell_class_is_not_a_set
theorems.description: Russell's class {x | x notin x} is a proper class, not a set.

theorems.name: binary_inter_comm
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { x | ((x in A) /\ (x in B)) }) -> (z in { x | ((x in B) /\ (x in A)) })))))
theorems.description: Binary class intersection is commutative.

theorems.name: binary_union_comm
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { x | ((x in A) \/ (x in B)) }) -> (z in { x | ((x in B) \/ (x in A)) })))))
theorems.description: Binary class union is commutative.

theorems.name: class_diff_subclass_left
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { x | ((x in A) /\ ((x in B) -> _|_)) }) -> (z in A)))))
theorems.description: The class difference A \ B is a subclass of A.

theorems.name: class_eq_sym
theorems.formula: (forall X:Class. (forall Y:Class. ((X = Y) -> (Y = X))))
theorems.description: Class equality is symmetric.

theorems.name: class_eq_trans
theorems.formula: (forall X:Class. (forall Y:Class. (forall Z:Class. (((X = Y) /\ (Y = Z)) -> (X = Z)))))
theorems.description: Class equality is transitive.

theorems.name: quantifier_swap
theorems.formula: (forall R:Class. ((exists y:Set. (forall x:Set. ([x, y]_D in R))) -> (forall x:Set. (exists y:Set. ([x, y]_D in R)))))
theorems.description: An existential set witness for a binary relation R implies the corresponding forall-exists statement.

theorems.name: dunaev_tagged_pair_projections
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. ((pr1([A, B]_D) = A) /\ (pr2([A, B]_D) = B))))
theorems.description: pr1([A,B]_D) = A and pr2([A,B]_D) = B for arbitrary classes.

theorems.name: cantor_diagonal_theorem
theorems.formula: (forall S:Class. (forall R:Class. (forall c:Class. ((c in S) -> ((((c in { x | ((x in S) /\ (([x, x]_D in R) -> _|_)) }) -> ([c, c]_D in R)) /\ (([c, c]_D in R) -> (c in { x | ((x in S) /\ (([x, x]_D in R) -> _|_)) }))) -> _|_)))))
theorems.description: Cantor's diagonal theorem on domain class S with Dunaev tagged pairs (using NBG Heredity to derive Set(c) from c in S).

theorems.name: self_in_singleton
theorems.formula: (forall x:Class. (Set(x) -> (x in { u | (u = x) })))
theorems.description: Every set belongs to its singleton class.

theorems.name: self_in_succ
theorems.formula: (forall x:Class. (Set(x) -> (x in { u | ((u in x) \/ (u = x)) })))
theorems.description: Every set belongs to its ordinal successor.

theorems.name: class_sub_succ
theorems.formula: (forall x:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in x) -> (z in { u | ((u in x) \/ (u = x)) }))))
theorems.description: Every class is a subclass of its successor.

theorems.name: dunaev_pair_injective
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall C:Class. (forall E:Class. (([A, B]_D = [C, E]_D) -> ((A = C) /\ (B = E)))))))
theorems.description: Dunaev pairs are injective for arbitrary classes: [A,B]_D = [C,E]_D -> A = C and B = E.

theorems.name: dunaev_cartesian_elim
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall p:Class. ((p in { q | (exists u:Set. (exists v:Set. (((u in A) /\ (v in B)) /\ (q = [u, v]_D)))) }) -> (exists u:Set. (exists v:Set. (((u in A) /\ (v in B)) /\ (p = [u, v]_D))))))))
theorems.description: Elimination for the Dunaev Cartesian product: membership yields set components u, v with p = [u,v]_D.

theorems.name: inter_sub_left
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { u | ((u in A) /\ (u in B)) }) -> (z in A)))))
theorems.description: Binary class intersection A inter B is a subclass of the left operand A.

theorems.name: inter_sub_right
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { u | ((u in A) /\ (u in B)) }) -> (z in B)))))
theorems.description: Binary class intersection A inter B is a subclass of the right operand B.

theorems.name: union_sub_left
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in A) -> (z in { u | ((u in A) \/ (u in B)) })))))
theorems.description: Left operand A is a subclass of the binary class union A union B (via NBG Heredity + Comprehension).

theorems.name: semi_singleton_sub_elim
theorems.formula: (forall s:Class. (forall A:Class. (forall x:Class. (forall y:Class. (((forall u:Class. ((u in s) -> (u in A))) /\ (forall u:Class. (forall v:Class. (((u in s) /\ (v in s)) -> (u = v))))) -> (((x in s) /\ (y in s)) -> ((x in A) /\ (x = y))))))))
theorems.description: Semi-singleton subset s c= A uniqueness and inclusion elimination (Foundations ch. 110).

theorems.name: family_fiber_char
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall s:Class. ((s in { u | (u c= A) }) -> (Set(s) /\ (s c= A)))))
theorems.description: Family value fiber comprehension characterization s in { u | u c= A } -> Set(s) /\ s c= A.

theorems.name: sigma_dependent_sum_intro
theorems.formula: (forall B:Class. (forall x:Set. (forall y:Set. ((Set([x, y]_D) /\ ((x in Dom(B)) /\ (y in ValOf(B, x)))) -> ([x, y]_D in { p | (exists a:Set. (exists b:Set. (((a in Dom(B)) /\ (b in ValOf(B, a))) /\ (p = [a, b]_D)))) })))))
theorems.description: Dependent sum (Sigma-type) Dunaev pair [x, y]_D introduction from x in Dom(B) and y in ValOf(B, x) (Foundations ch. 130).

theorems.name: pi_dependent_product_elim
theorems.formula: (forall B:Class. (forall f:Class. (forall x:Class. (((forall u:Class. ((u in Dom(B)) -> (ValOf(f, u) in ValOf(B, u)))) /\ (x in Dom(B))) -> (ValOf(f, x) in ValOf(B, x))))))
theorems.description: Dependent product (Pi-type) section evaluation elimination: ValOf(f, x) in ValOf(B, x) for x in Dom(B) (Foundations ch. 130).

theorems.name: union_sub_right
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall B:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in B) -> (z in { u | ((u in A) \/ (u in B)) })))))
theorems.description: Right operand B is a subclass of the binary class union A union B (via NBG Heredity + Comprehension).

theorems.name: model_stratification_trans
theorems.formula: (forall W:Class. (forall Q:Class. (forall T:Class. (forall F:Class. (((forall z:Class. ((z in Model(W)) -> (z in Model(Q)))) /\ ((forall z:Class. ((z in Model(Q)) -> (z in Model(T)))) /\ (forall z:Class. ((z in Model(T)) -> (z in Model(F)))))) -> (forall z:Class. ((z in Model(W)) -> (z in Model(F)))))))))
theorems.description: Metalevel theory stratification transitivity: (Model(W) c= Model(Q) /\ Model(Q) c= Model(T) /\ Model(T) c= Model(F)) -> Model(W) c= Model(F) (Entry 6.01).

theorems.name: if_dep_true_elim
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall T1:Class. (forall T2:Class. (forall x:Class. (forall z:Class. (((((x in A) -> (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T1, x))) /\ (((x in A) -> _|_) -> (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T2, x)))) /\ ((x in A) /\ (z in if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x))))) -> (z in ValOf(T1, x))))))))
theorems.description: Constructive dependent conditional (if_dep) true-branch membership elimination via Leibniz rewriting (Entry 3.24).

theorems.name: if_dep_false_elim
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall T1:Class. (forall T2:Class. (forall x:Class. (forall z:Class. (((((x in A) -> (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T1, x))) /\ (((x in A) -> _|_) -> (if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x)) = ValOf(T2, x)))) /\ (((x in A) -> _|_) /\ (z in if_dep(x, A, ValOf(T1, x), ValOf(T2, x))))) -> (z in ValOf(T2, x))))))))
theorems.description: Constructive dependent conditional (if_dep) false-branch membership elimination via Leibniz rewriting (Entry 3.24).

theorems.name: inter_idempotent_elim
theorems.formula: (forall A:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { u | ((u in A) /\ (u in A)) }) -> (z in A))))
theorems.description: Binary class intersection idempotence elimination: z in A inter A -> z in A.

theorems.name: singleton_membership_eq
theorems.formula: (forall a:Class. (forall z:Class. ((z in { u | (u = a) }) -> (z = a))))
theorems.description: Singleton membership inversion: z in {a} -> z = a.
